Public Records Search

A majority of our records are related to real estate. Some of the documents our office stores include: deeds, mortgages, releases, liens, assignments, plats, leases and partnerships. There are two documents that we are charged with safekeeping that are not real estate related and are not viewable by the public. These two documents are Living Wills/Healthcare Powers of Attorney and Veteran Discharges (DD-214). If you would like to search our records online, feel free to use the link below to our Cloud Search platform to get started. Contact our office if you need assistance with searching our records and one of our Customer Service team members can walk you through how to use our website. Disclaimer: our employees cannot perform a title search for you. If you need an extensive title search done on a property we recommend reaching out to a title company or attorney for that service.

Cloud Search Website

Search Our Records

Using the Cloud Search website does not require account registration, but does offer additional functionality if you choose to create an account. You can watch the below training video to get you started, plus there is a knowledgebase and product tour available under the Help menu on the search website if you need further guidance.

Cloud Search Training Video

 
Additional Property Information

If you are needing more information about a property, we recommend visiting the Auditor's property search.

Visit the Auditor's Property Search     

 

If you are needing more information about taxes on a property, we recommend visiting the Treasurer's property search.

Visit the Treasurer's Property Search    

 

Legacy Search Website

Below is a link to our Legacy Search website. This website is older and is not as fast as the newer Cloud Search platform. All of the records we keep can be found on both websites.

Search Using Our Legacy Site

Using this search site also does not require registration or an account. However, if registered, additional functionality such as the ability to save specific searches and administering your escrow account will be available to you. There is a Search Guide located within the search site for reference in case you are unsure how to utilize the site as well as the training video below which goes more in depth.

Legacy Search Training Video
